title: Deliver Gold to Farfingford Bank
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Gold** delivered to **Farfingford Bank** (industry id 8, near tile 31,41).

A likely supplier is **Budingworth Gold Mine** (industry id 7, near tile 35,22); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **4,000 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
